messages:
ana_partnerships: Quick ask ": we need a compact SI onboarding addendum for hardware partners who use regional resellers. Goal: one A4 page checklist + 3 Slack snippets mentors can paste. Can someone take this?

liam_ops: I can draft the checklist. Keep it operational: pre-flight, customs flags, vendor contact, and a go/no-go column.

maya_enable: I'll write the Slack snippets and a tiny mentor badge addendum (what qualifies as a shadow vs proctored practical). Keep badge rules simple.

ravi_marketplace: I'll export the reseller map and flag SKUs that historically require tax docs. Can attach a 1-line CSV link.

onboard-bot: Task created: #ONB-6102 "SI onboarding addendum: reseller flows" assigned to liam_ops, due 2024-09-10.

ana_partnerships: small note: partners asked for a one-click copy for mentors to request partner-run validation. Example: "Hi @partner, please run validation.sh and paste output". Make it non-technical as some partners forward to procurement teams.

liam_ops: good point. I'll include both a technical snippet and a plain-language request. Tech snippet will be the small bash check (nvidia-smi + curl to asset).

maya_enable: badge idea: mentors get 'Reseller-ready' tag after 2 successful regional cohorts and passing one proctored customs scenario. We'll keep expiry 12 months.

ravi_marketplace: CSV ready. Column headers: sku, reseller_id, country, tax_flag, sample_vendor_email. I will link in doc once liam has the checklist.

liam_ops: draft checklist outline: 1) Confirm voucher redemption screenshot 2) Run interop script -> attach output 3) Confirm shipping docs (taxID, proforma) 4) Contact vendor if reseller flow required 5) Go/No-Go decision.

onboard-bot: Reminder: Meeting scheduled ": SI reseller flows review" 2024-09-12 15:00 UTC. Invite sent.

maya_enable: I'll post the 3 Slack snippets in this thread tomorrow. Snippets: mentor check-in, partner preflight request (plain), vendor followup template.

ana_partnerships: timeline ok? We want the addendum in partners docs before next cohort (late Sep).

liam_ops: will have a one-page PDF draft by 2024-09-09.

ravi_marketplace: I'll attach CSV by 2024-09-09 too.

maya_enable: badge text + snippets done by 2024-09-10.

ana_partnerships: thanks team. Please keep updates in this thread and tag me for any legal questions.

liam_ops: linked an internal template i'm reusing: https://redwood.internal/templates/si-reseller-checklist (will copy edits into partner doc).

onboard-bot: Tasks updated: #ONB-6102 assigned, due 2024-09-10; #ONB-6104 "mentor snippets + badge text" assigned to maya_enable, due 2024-09-10.
